subject: Senior ML Engineer — immigration & relocation cost approval
messages:
From: Rebecca Ortiz <rebecca.ortiz@talentpartners.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate Diego Ramirez — offer components + relocation ask

Hi Hannah,

Quick update from the final conversation with Diego (Senior ML Engineer candidate). He is excited about the role and verbally accepted the baseline base + equity we discussed. He flagged two items that will impact the offer economics and timing:

- He needs Redwood to sponsor his H-1B transfer (currently on OPT, Indian passport).
- He requested a structured relocation package: temporary housing + lump-sum moving allowance; he asked whether Redwood covers immigration legal fees up-front or by reimbursement.

He asked for a written offer before Friday if possible. Can we confirm the policy around immigration legal fees (pay up-front vs reimbursed) and whether we can approve a lump-sum of up to $12,000 for relocation (candidate provided a rough estimate).

I've attached the candidate's relocation estimate and a draft offer template.

Thanks,
Rebecca

--
Rebecca Ortiz
Senior Recruiter, Talent Partners
(recruiter for Redwood hiring)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Candidate Diego Ramirez — offer components + relocation ask

Folks — forwarding Rebecca's note. Diego is strong and fits the senior ML opening; we want to move fast. Two asks for approvals:

1) Immigration legal fees: proposal is Redwood pays vendor directly for H-1B transfer + premium processing (estimate attached, ~$5,500). Alternatively we could offer reimbursement on receipt, but candidate prefers vendor-paid.

2) Relocation: request is temporary housing (up to 6 weeks) + lump-sum moving allowance. Rebecca proposed a max lump-sum of $12k. My suggestion: approve vendor-paid immigration fees + a relocation package capped at $10k lump-sum + up to 4 weeks temporary housing, with exceptions reviewed by HR.

Dev — need headcount/comp band sign-off and confirmation this fits current compcommit. Grace — can you confirm finance/relocation budget and whether we should route this through People Ops policy exception?

If we can get approvals today, I'll finalize offer and ask legal to issue sponsor engagement.

Thanks,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Recruiting Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate Diego Ramirez — offer components + relocation ask

Hannah / Grace —

I reviewed comp band for Senior ML Engineer (IC4). The proposed base + equity is within band for US west region. Headcount is available on IC hiring plan Q3-Q4. Approving the role headcount is fine.

Relocation: $10k lump-sum + 4 weeks temp housing is acceptable as an exception for highly senior hires given market. Please route the final amount through People Ops for record.

Immigration fees: we prefer Redwood pays the vendor directly to avoid reimbursements and delays. Finance will need the invoice and PO. Estimated cost $5.5k is reasonable; approve vendor invoicing directly to Redwood.

Laura — FYI for budget sign-off and any additional audit/tracking we need for sponsored hires.

—Dev

--
Dev Patel
Director, ML Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate Diego Ramirez — offer components + relocation ask

All —

Finance and People Ops confirm we can approve the exception. Notes:

- Relocation: cap the lump-sum at $10,000 (taxable benefit per payroll), and we will arrange temporary housing for up to 4 weeks through our relocation partner. Candidate must submit receipts for any reimbursed expenses beyond the lump-sum.
- Immigration: approved to pay immigration vendor directly. We will need a signed engagement letter from Priya's firm and an invoice to process. Please include the cost center 4012-HR for tracking.
- Documentation: add a one-line clause in the offer that immigration fees will be covered by the company and subject to clawback if candidate departs within 6 months (standard).

I'll circulate the HR exception memo to Legal for review of the clause language.

Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Head of People Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Priya Nair <priya.nair@immigrationsvc.com>, Diego Ramirez <diego.ramirez@example.com>
Cc: Rebecca Ortiz <rebecca.ortiz@talentpartners.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Offer + immigration & relocation next steps for Diego Ramirez

Hi Priya / Diego —

Good news: leadership and People Ops approved the offer and the immigration / relocation exceptions. Summary of approved items: 

- Redwood will engage your firm (Immigration Svc LLC) to handle H-1B transfer + premium processing. Redwood will pay the vendor directly; estimated vendor fees $5,500. Please send engagement letter and invoice instructions to finance@redwood.com and CC me.
- Relocation: one-time lump-sum of $10,000 (taxable) + up to 4 weeks temporary housing booked through Redwood's relocation partner. Candidate may submit receipts for any overage for discretionary review.
- Immigration fee clawback: as discussed, clause will be in the offer: fees covered by Redwood, subject to pro-rated repayment if employee voluntarily leaves within 6 months.

Diego — Rebecca will send the formal offer package (RDW-offer-senior-ml-v3.pdf) with the above language. Please confirm your target start date window (we had discussed late Oct — please confirm availability for H-1B timing).

Priya — next step: engagement letter + invoice to finance (cc Hannah). Rebecca will introduce you to Diego separately to collect documents.

Thanks everyone — moving to finalize the offer.

Best,
Hannah

--
